notConnected.title: Connect your Facebook Page
notConnected.description: Messages to your Page will show up here, and you can answer them without leaving ezycore.
notConnected.askOwner: Ask the shop owner to connect the Facebook Page in Inbox settings.

list.emptyHint: When a customer messages your Page, the chat shows up here.

thread.pickHint: Pick a chat on the left to read and reply.
thread.windowClosed: Facebook only allows a reply within 24 hours of the customer's last message. You can reply again when they write.
thread.openInMeta: {type} — open it in Meta Business Suite

settings.title: Inbox settings
settings.subtitle: Connect the Facebook Page whose Messenger chats come here
settings.stepsTitle: Before you start — in your Meta app
settings.step1: On developers.facebook.com, create an app with the “Engage with customers on Messenger” use case, in the same business portfolio as your Page.
settings.step2: App settings → Basic: add an icon, a privacy policy URL and a data deletion URL, then copy the App Secret.
settings.step3: Messenger → API settings → Generate access tokens: connect your Page, copy its Page ID and generate the Page access token.
settings.step4: Paste them below and save. Then paste the Callback URL and Verify token we show you into Configure webhooks.
settings.step5: Click Add subscriptions on your Page and tick messages and message_echoes. Then publish the app.
settings.pageIdHint: The number under your Page's name in Messenger API settings.
settings.tokenHint: Starts with EAA. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
settings.secretHint: App settings → Basic → App secret. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
settings.webhookHint: In your Meta app: Messenger → API settings → Configure webhooks. Paste these two values and click Verify and save.
settings.webhookNotVerified: Facebook has not checked the webhook yet
settings.subscribeHint: Then click Add subscriptions next to your Page and tick messages and message_echoes.
settings.disconnectDescription: New messages will stop arriving. Chats already received stay here, and reconnecting the same Page continues them.

oauth.title: Connect with Facebook
oauth.description: Log in with the Facebook account that manages your Page and pick the Page. ezycore sets up the rest — nothing to copy.
oauth.pickHint: These are the Pages you gave ezycore access to on Facebook. One Page per workspace.
oauth.noPages: Facebook returned no Pages. Connect again and tick the Page in the Facebook window.
oauth.cannotMessage: Your Facebook role on this Page can't answer messages
oauth.expired: This Facebook sign-in has expired. Click Connect with Facebook again.
oauth.ownAppToggle: Use your own Meta app instead (advanced)

errors.INBOX_OAUTH_SESSION_INVALID: The Facebook sign-in expired. Please try again.
errors.INBOX_OAUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Connect with Facebook is not available right now. Use your own Meta app instead.
errors.failed: Facebook sign-in didn't work. Please try again.

ai.title: AI replies
ai.unavailable: AI replies aren't available on your workspace yet. Your team answers every chat.
ai.enableHint: The AI answers product, price, stock and delivery questions from your own catalogue, and hands the chat to your team for orders, complaints, photos or anything it can't answer. Chats already with your team stay with them — use Give back to AI in the chat.
ai.holding: Message when a chat goes to your team
ai.holdingPlaceholder: Thanks! A team member will reply shortly.
ai.holdingHint: Sent once when the AI hands a chat over and has nothing else to say. Leave empty to send nothing.
ai.idle: Give the chat back to AI when your team is quiet for
ai.idleHint: After your team replies, the AI stays out of the chat. It answers again when the customer writes after this long without a staff reply.

idleChoice.0: Never — only when we give it back
